metadata.description: Handy tools for problems that come up during mobile development — one plugin per tool.

plugins.name: figma-design-to-artifact
plugins.description: Export Figma nodes into technical-requirement artifacts by driving Chrome: labeled sample code from the "Figma to Code" plugin plus a 2x PNG screenshot for each node, falling back to Figma's CSS for all layers plus a JSON layer tree when there is no Dev Mode.

plugins.name: store-submission-prep
plugins.description: Scan a mobile app codebase (iOS, Android, React Native/Expo, Flutter) and write a prefilled handover sheet covering the App Store Connect and Play Console fields for a first-time submission.
